address: Ringwood Rd, Burley, New Forest, Hampshire ,BH24 4BS
bio: Built in 1852 by Colonel William Clement Drake Esdaile, Burley Manor is an architecturally stunning baronial-style manor house set within an eight-hundred year old estate and surrounded by rolling countryside and Burley Park, New Forest – a red deer sanctuary. It’s also just a few minutes’ walk from the picture-perfect village of Burley.  Food is the heart of Burley Manor and takes inspirations from the Mediterranean, offering not only a classic Afternoon Tea menu, but a Afternoon Tapas and fizz experience too!  The Afternoon Teas are experienced in multiple locations in the Manor. First, in the Drawing room with elegant and rich colours, sumptuous seating, and views over the neighbouring deer park. Should the weather be warm an opportunity to sit outside on the terrace is a must, with stunning views across the deer park. For larger parties with offer the comfort of the conservatory, with beautiful Mediterranean inspired décor.
